title: cloth plate trivet
text: cloth plate trivet. i purchased 2 of these... because of the material - they are slippery... eh.  They are also a little bigger than I need for my plates.. guess I have small plates.  I machine washed them and dried them in my dryer close - they did fine with that.  I am going to keep looking for different ones because these are too slippery for me - sort of defeats the purpose in my opinion.

product_metadata.title: Microwavable Heat Resistant Plate Holder Cozy Protects Hands and Fingers From Hot Dishes. Microwave and Washing Machine Safe Hugger For Heating Soup or Leftover Meals To Eat Dinner and Watch TV
features: HOLD HOT PLATES OR DISHES SAFELY AND COMFORTABLY. Take your meal or leftovers out of the microwave instantly and eat your food while still hot instead of waiting until able to touch and carry the dish
MICROWAVE AND WASHING MACHINE SAFE. The heat resistant fabric material will not get hot so it protects your hands from heated plates, bowls and other dishes. Easily clean in the washer between uses
MAKES A GREAT GIFT. No one likes to get burned! Anyone could use these convenient dish cozies. Easy to use and handy to have around

AWESOME GADGET FOR ALL AGES. Perfect for kids with small delicate fingers, college students in a rush to heat their ramen or easy mac between classes, seniors who want something easier to hold or more
DOUBLES AS A COASTER TO PROTECT FURNITURE SURFACES. Place your hot dish on even the most fragile wooden table tops with confidence knowing you won't leave a ring or damage your paint, stain or finish
